 Print SSC releases SI CPO 2026 exam city details The Staff Selection Commission ( SSC ) has released the examination city details for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) examination 2026. Paper 1 of the examination will be conducted from November 23 to November 28, 2026. Candidates can check their examination city details and admission certificates by logging in to the designated section of the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in. The admission certificate will tentatively be available for download 2 to 3 days before the respective examination date. SSC CPO 2026 examination city details
 Candidates appearing for the examination can check their allotted examination city by visiting the official SSC website and logging in through the designated module. The commission has advised candidates to follow the instructions mentioned in the examination notice for downloading their admission certificates. SSC CPO 2026: Important notice for 21,000 candidates
 The commission has also reported discrepancies in the matriculation qualification details of approximately 21,000 candidates who applied for the examination. Join conversation

 Although these candidates have been provisionally allowed to appear for the examination, they must upload a copy of their Class 10 marksheet through the candidate portal on ssc.gov.in. Candidates must complete this process before November 20, 2026, to avoid any inconvenience during the result processing stage. The concerned candidates are also being contacted through email by their respective SSC Regional Offices. Candidates should keep checking the official SSC website for updates regarding their admission certificates. They should also ensure that the required Class 10 marksheet is uploaded within the deadline, if applicable. Direct link here.
